summary: America Movil filed a Form 6-K reporting that it is unaware of the cause of unusual trading volume in its Series B shares on May 29, 2026. The company disclosed it acquired 22,850,000 Series B shares that day as part of its ongoing share buyback program. It stated there is no pending disclosure of any relevant event and no knowledge of transactions by board members or senior management. This is a routine market inquiry response and share buyback disclosure under Mexican securities law, not a special situation event. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is announced.
